prepare_pt2e_post_training_quantization: prepare a model for post-training quantization using a backend-specific quantizer
prepare_qat_model_quantization_aware: prepare a model for quantization-aware training with fake quant modules based on quantizer annotation
convert_pt2e_quantized_model: convert a calibrated or trained model to a quantized model with quantize-dequantize ops
